title: Exotic Pet Monitoring, No Experience Required
description: Watch a clutch of eggs belonging to a client currently traveling. Payment is withheld if an egg is damaged.

monsters.name: Flying Snake
monsters.note: Reskin as an egg-thief serpent slipping in through a vent or window.

monsters.name: Giant Owl
monsters.note: Reskin as a swooping predator drawn by the nest's warmth, more nuisance than threat.

title: Overnight Starter Guard
description: A bakery needs its sourdough starter protected from a rival baker for one night.

monsters.name: Bandit
monsters.note: Reskin as a hired saboteur sent to sabotage or steal the starter.

monsters.name: Commoner
monsters.note: Reskin as the rival baker themselves, for a confrontation meant to stay non-lethal.

title: Companion Reading Service
description: A retired treant, unable to turn its own pages, pays for someone to read aloud daily over the course of a week.

title: Waterproof Courier Needed
description: Deliver letters to a partner across a body of water. Some means of breathing underwater required.

title: Seasonal Harvest, Time-Sensitive
description: A Feywild garden opens once a season and needs a specific fruit harvested before the opening closes.

title: Escort: One Modron, Straight Line Preferred
description: A minor Modron separated from Mechanus needs guidance back to a portal, insisting on a perfectly straight route regardless of terrain.

title: Deep Clean, Some Shrinkage Possible
description: Routine house-cleaning job. Terms and conditions apply.
